nodes.description: Private mapping counting how many sale-transfers each address has performed; used by condition() to throttle sellers.
Private whitelist mapping: addresses flagged true bypass all sale restrictions in ensure().
Private minimum sale amount (scaled by decimals) checked in condition().
Private maximum sale amount (scaled by decimals) checked in condition().
Private maximum number of sell operations allowed per address.
Address granted unrestricted transfer rights in ensure(); writable only by owner via setTradeAddress.
Public token balance mapping; mutated by transferFrom, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested allowance mapping; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Constant 18 decimals used when scaling min/max sale and total supply.
Public total supply set once in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Private privileged address; bypasses ensure() checks and gates delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address which is unconditionally whitelisted in ensure().
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist gate; returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
Public transfer implementation: allowance handling, ensure() whitelist, balance accounting and _onSaleNum increment. State is updated before the events but no external call is made.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view anti-dump logic enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-gated delegatecall proxy that executes arbitrary user-supplied code in the token's storage context (backdoor).
Owner-only initializer for _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum; uses unchecked raw multiplication.
Owner-only mass transfer; computes total = _value * _tos.length (unchecked) and emits two half-value Transfer events per recipient while crediting full _value.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist bypass address.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation using CREATE2 init-code hash.
Payable constructor: mints the entire supply to the deployer, sets owner = msg.sender and grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys, whitelist checks and balance accounting.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate(address a, bytes b) executing attacker-influenceable code with this contract's storage.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend, susceptible to integer overflow.
